description: Five scripted phone calls (three scams, two normal), spoken by macOS synthetic voices, transcribed by ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (real API), and checked against fixed red-flag rules.
limits: Scripted calls and synthetic voices, not real scam recordings.
Five cases: a demonstration, not a measured accuracy rate.
Rules look at what is said; they do not detect whether a voice is AI-generated.
Not run through the live ElevenLabs agent.

flags.label: Asks for a code, PIN or password
Wants gift cards, crypto or a wire transfer
Asks you to install an app or give remote access
Threatens arrest, fines or a frozen account
Pressures you to act right now
Tells you to keep it secret or stay on the line
Claims to be a government agency or your bank’s fraud team

cases.script: This is the Canada Revenue Agency. You owe back taxes, and a warrant will be issued for your arrest today unless you pay immediately with gift cards. Do not hang up.

cases.verdict_text: Likely scam: hang up, and call back using the number on your card or the official website.
